# raw AT 回包样本（含 echo / URC / 终止符），供 transport 分类测试
--- ECELLMEAS 正常（含 echo 与 +EDMFAPP URC 干扰） ---
AT+ECELLMEAS?

+EDMFAPP: 6,24,2

+ECELLMEAS: 11,426030,784,-317,-46,29,"594FCB484",1,"46011","CHN-CT",1,38880

+EDMFAPP: 6,24,2

+ECELLMEAS: 11,426030,493,-395,-52,2,"5959A0401",1,"46011","CHN-CT",1,38880

OK

--- 未知命令（CME ERROR 4 = unknown command，本固件无 QENG 的判定依据） ---
AT+QENG="servingcell"

+CME ERROR: 4

--- EMMCHLCK 查询 ---
AT+EMMCHLCK?

+EMMCHLCK: 0

OK

--- EMMCHLCK 能力探测 ---
AT+EMMCHLCK=?

+EMMCHLCK: (0-3),(0,2,7,11),(0,1),(0-2279165),(0-1007)

OK

--- C5GREG（示例格式，字段序按 TS 27.007） ---
AT+C5GREG?

+C5GREG: 2,1,"1A2B3C","594FCB484",11

OK
